name: How does underage DUI impact accident rates in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How does underage DUI impact accident rates in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Statistics show people under 21 in San Diego have a much higher risk for DUI crashes; about 25% of fatal car accidents involve underage drinking.sandiego​
